clock.sampling: Sample and hold from actual retained observations; no interpolation, fabricated events, wall-clock coupling or predicted telemetry.

provenance.nativeExecution: Retained original Luminary 099 instructions through pinned Virtual AGC; browser playback does not run the AGC.
provenance.integrity: Sealed Phase 10 files, rope, raw/compressed traces, checkpoint mappings, DSKY decoder and original read-only analysis verified before export.

labels.scenario: SYNTHETIC lunar mission inputs with published preflight target padloads; not the historical Apollo 11 trajectory.
labels.replay: RECORDED AUTHENTIC EXECUTION REPLAY. Playback controls explore existing traces and do not send commands to a live AGC.
labels.clock: Replay position uses CPU-call time. Observed AGC clock and initialized navigation epoch are separate quantities; observations are held until the next recorded readback.
labels.timeToGo: Signed original ROOTPSRS time-to-go result (seconds). Negative values retain the original guidance convention; this is not time remaining until ignition.
labels.ignitionTime: Absolute TIG in the synthetic mission clock, available only after original IGNALGRT completes.
labels.ignitionLead: TIG minus observed AGC clock at the same IGNALGRT checkpoint. Held solution lead, not a continuously updated countdown.
labels.dsky: Actual channel 010 digit relay fields from the retained Phase 1 decoder. Blank and unknown digits are preserved; sign lamps are not decoded by this display adapter.
labels.projection: Static X–Z projection: spacecraft at initialized epoch 120 s; planned site at nominal TLAND 784.4 s. These markers are not simultaneous observations. Orbit outline is an independent circular-state illustration; no spacecraft trajectory is replayed or propagated.
labels.scope: Pre-ignition numerical guidance only. Physical alignment calibration, engine ignition, thrust response, powered descent and landing are NOT RUN.
